note: multinom(y ~ x1 + x2) Newton-polished to the MLE. keys category-major: <level>:(intercept), <level>:x1, <level>:x2 per non-reference level in fitted order (categories: reference first, then the observed levels in dictionary order); vcov row-major over keys; fitted_probabilities row-major n x L over categories; score_probabilities / score_log_odds row-major (score rows) x L over categories, log-odds vs the reference; holdout = the weighted proper scores of holdout_rows [x1, x2, y(, w)] (a row at a dropped level scores nothing): log_loss = mean -ln P(y), brier = mean sum_k (P_k - [y = k])^2, accuracy = mean [first argmax = y] in dictionary order.
